patch.description: Enables or disables a managed organization user. Requires authentication within the configured recent-authentication window (10 minutes by default). Invited accounts cannot be enabled without completing activation. Disabling increments the security epoch and revokes every session; enabling never restores them. Role assignment, organization scope and the last active school administrator guard are enforced by the server.

get.description: Returns newest-first immutable image-quality runs for one submission page. Results include explainable metrics, local focus map, hard-gate outcomes, and normalization evidence; worker lease secrets are never exposed.

Read-only recovery using the saved remote_upload_id. processing covers uploading/finalizing; succeeded preserves file/capture identifiers; failed preserves error_code. A 404 means the ID is not visible in this tenant, not permission to invent a new command. If init response was lost, repeat init using the original immutable identity and content hash.

metadata.description: Bounded non-secret display metadata such as AI mode and data-export booleans.

secret.description: One-time enrollment secret; do not cache, log, or persist in browser storage.

qr_code_data_url.description: Locally generated PNG data URL, never a remote QR service.

items.description: High-entropy single-use recovery code, returned only once.

public_device.description: Browser-only public computer mode. It cannot be combined with remember_device.

MathCriterionCandidate.description: Untrusted mapping hint; no point score or total is accepted. A model candidate alone cannot settle a criterion.

MathRubricScoreResponse.description: Read-only server-computed preview from the frozen exam rubric and current effective verified math evidence. Uncertain points have null awarded_score and are excluded from missing_points. suggested_score is null while score-bearing decisions remain unresolved. No final-grade authority.

MathUnderstandingContract.description: Mathematical evidence contract without immutable artifact metadata. Effective evidence is the base contract or the latest teacher correction, identified separately by artifact version and correction revision.

expected_correction_revision.description: Optional optimistic lock on the effective correction revision. New clients send zero for an uncorrected artifact. Omitted by legacy clients.

correction_revision.description: Latest projected correction revision for this artifact; zero when uncorrected. Independent of the bounded correction history.

verification_status.description: Scheduling outcome after the correction is saved; queued does not mean verified.

verification_task_id.description: Empty unless verification was successfully queued.

segment_image_url.description: Authenticated URL for the cropped answer image; image bytes are not embedded in this response.

original_image_url.description: Role-restricted authenticated URL for the original page image.

score_prefill_allowed.description: Always false for R3 HUMAN_PRIMARY review contexts.

metadata.description: AI provenance, confidence, evidence and risk metadata. Score-shaped fields are omitted for R3 HUMAN_PRIMARY contexts.

history.description: Latest task-scoped AI suggestion projections, newest first. Historical rows are retained; score-shaped fields are omitted for R3 HUMAN_PRIMARY contexts.

expected_revision.description: The same review_task revision required by draft/submit/return mutations; no parallel scoring revision is created.

draft.description: The assigned reviewer's current draft, or null on first open and for queue managers.

CanonicalImageGeometry.description: Normalized coordinates measured against the orientation-corrected original page image. x+width and y+height must not exceed 1.

StudentReviewAnnotation.description: Student-safe DTO. Private annotations, tenant/actor IDs, revision, visibility and internal payload are structurally absent. It is only exposed through a current published result scoped to the authenticated student.

parser_policy.description: Required parser capabilities and quality policy. Presence does not assert that a real parser is deployed.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision; use 0 when creating the first configuration.

CalibrationGoldSample.description: Reference score and expected criterion values are deliberately omitted before submission.

selected_region.description: Optional canonical answer-crop rectangle: coordinate_space=canonical_image_normalized with x, y, width and height in [0,1].

selector_hash.description: Binds the normalized tenant/exam/question selector and original grade snapshot. Submit the preview hash when creating; a changed snapshot returns 409 backmark_preview_stale. Optional for existing API clients.

Binds the normalized tenant/exam/question selector and original grade snapshot. Submit the preview hash when creating; a changed snapshot returns 409 backmark_preview_stale. Optional for existing API clients.

regrade_required_count.description: Count across the entire batch, independent of item pagination and status filter.

pending_count.description: Count across the entire batch, independent of item pagination and status filter.

completed_count.description: Count across the entire batch, independent of item pagination and status filter.

generated_at.description: Time the durable processing projection most recently completed; epoch when it has not run yet.

projected_at.description: Most recent durable projection completion in the selected scope.

math_artifact_id.description: Exact verified math artifact used by the server scorer.

SubjectiveAIGrade.description: Teacher-review-only AI suggestion. The four optional math binding fields are emitted together for math grading v2. This object is never a final_grade.

critical.description: Minimum of all required mathematical evidence quality dimensions.

MathSemanticCandidate.description: Untrusted score-free LLM mapping candidate. It cannot award or deny a rubric point.

MathGradingReviewResponse.description: No ai_grade is persisted and suggested_score remains null when any required criterion is unresolved.

payload.description: Immutable request payload returned only when a stale command reservation is eligible for authenticated takeover.

result.description: Immutable operation result: submit/ arbitration/publish response, confirmation grade array, or report CSV envelope.
